_note: Routing corpus for tool-stress — orchestrates a full MULTI-technique stress-test/eval CAMPAIGN against a running system (build a scoring harness, then run adversarial → ablation → sweep → hill-climb → autoresearch with bisect as a safety net, iterating to a target score). Positives span the invocation families (imperative stress-test/harden, 'get this to 95%', object-first 'audit this codebase'). Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from NAMED peers it is confusable with: core-mcp-best-practices (DESIGNING/reviewing an MCP server's tool perimeter — schemas, descriptions, permissions, selection eval — NOT load/stress-testing a running system), research-survey (runs ONE technique at a time, no campaign/harness/target-score orchestration), the *-decomposer GRADE modes (grade ONE artifact against a fixed two-axis rubric — code/regex/query/type/config — not a multi-round improve-to-target campaign), and skills-studio EVAL (behavioral test cases for a SKILL, not a system stress campaign). routing-eval is LEXICAL OVERLAP only; 'stress test'/'evaluate' overlap with research-survey is expected — the discriminator is the CAMPAIGN/harness/target, which a lexical proxy can't fully see.
